name: Deer Lake
reason: Pin sits on GNIS-era Deer Lake coordinate and matches the stored lake; the stored 0.8 was just a copy of Sol Duc Falls. WTA's Deer Lake out-and-back from the Sol Duc trailhead is 8.0 mi roundtrip, so 4.0 cumulative from pin 0. Later pins (10.5, 11.5, ...) stay possible; straight line TH to lake is about 2.0 mi.

name: Spider Gap / Spider Glacier remnant
quote: GNIS coordinates match both stored pins to 5 decimals
reason: Both coordinates are verified by GNIS, so the stored 7.7 (1.2 beyond the meadow) is the wrong record against 2.1 mi straight line. No published trail mileage to the gap: WTA gives only 13.0 mi roundtrip to Spider Meadow/Phelps Basin and a 2019 trip report estimate for the gap, which I will not write.

name: Heliotrope Creek crossing
source: 3DEP at stored coordinate: 5,533 ft vs stored elev 4,600 ft
quote: n/a (no published coordinate for the crossing)
reason: The coordinate has computed-looking fractional digits, sits 933 ft above its claimed height, and makes the Kulshan Cabin 0.2 mi leg impossible (0.7 mi apart). Kulshan Cabin ground 4,634 matches its 4,700, so the crossing is the wrong half. GNIS has no crossing; nothing publishes it, so clear.

name: Source Lake junction
source: GNIS 1526120 Source Lake 47.455560,-121.452022 (matches Source Lake basin pin)
reason: The basin pin is verified by GNIS (and ground 3,750 vs 3,780), so it is right; the junction must come before the basin on the trail, so the stored 1.8 (same as basin) is wrong. No published spur mileage, so null the distance. Junction coordinate (ground 3,726 vs 4,100) left as is; no source to move it.

name: The Catwalk
source: 3DEP at stored coordinate 5,198 ft vs stored elev 5,550
reason: The Catwalk is described near the top of pitch 4, between Pineapple Pass (ground 5,282) and the summit, but the coordinate lies south of the pass on ground 5,198, below the pass. Nothing publishes a Catwalk coordinate, so clear. The 5,280 vs 5,606 cross-route note concerns another route's pin; here elev 5,550 is plausible and untouched.

name: Source Lake basin, Alpental valley
reason: Coordinate matches GNIS and ground 3,750 vs stored 3,780; the pin is right on this route. Any 320 ft elev outlier belongs to another route's copy.

name: Erosion gully to headwall waterfall
source: 3DEP at stored coordinate 4,222 ft vs claimed 6,500
reason: Fractional computed coordinate 2,300 ft below its stated height, in the basin below the gully. Prose supports the 6,500 ft claim, so the coordinate is the wrong half, and nothing publishes it.

name: Cliff-band crux ledge
source: 3DEP at stored coordinate 4,526 ft vs claimed 6,650
reason: Same fabricated-interpolation pattern as the gully pin: 2,100 ft below the stated height. Nothing publishes a coordinate for the ledge.

name: Gorge Creek bridge, SR 20 (~MP 123) — descent exit and shuttle car
second_source: Route text places the bridge ~2.6 mi east of Newhalem; GNIS point is 2.6 mi from Newhalem
reason: Stored coordinate has ground 4,356 ft, impossible for a road at 1,096 ft. GNIS Gorge Creek (mouth, at SR 20 / Gorge Lake) reads 903 ft, within 200 ft of the stated 1,096. The north face route uses Stetattle Creek (Diablo) as its trailhead and this pin is its descent exit, so only this pin moves.

name: Gorge Creek bridge / Gorge Creek Falls parking, SR 20 (~MP 123)
second_source: Route text places the bridge ~2.6 mi east of Newhalem; GNIS point is 2.6 mi from Newhalem
reason: This route's trailhead really is the Gorge Creek bridge (its text), but the stored coordinate is 3,260 ft uphill from the road. Moved to the GNIS Gorge Creek point; summit is 2.05 mi straight vs stored 3.1 trail mi, still possible.

name: The Barrier ridge crossing
source: 3DEP at stored coordinate 3,109 ft vs claimed 6,100
reason: Computed coordinate 3,000 ft below the stated crossing height, which the route's own prose gives as about 6,100 ft. Nothing publishes the point, so clear.

name: Eye Col
reason: Eye Col is the notch immediately beside the summit block of East/West Twin Needle (prose: 'sits atop Eye Col immediately adjacent'), so 43 m from the summit pin is plausible; ground is 95 ft below the summit as a col should be. Not a defect.

name: Oval Creek / Oval Lakes Trail junction
source: 3DEP at stored coordinate 8,424 ft vs claimed 6,200
reason: Coordinate is on the 8,400 ft ridge, 2,200 ft above a trail junction at 6,200 ft that must lie below Middle Oval Lake (6,940, ground 6,805). Nothing publishes the junction, so clear.

name: Dutch Miller Gap Trailhead
quote: Walk or bike the closed road about 7.5 miles beyond the gate to this old road end
reason: Both are real: Dingford Creek Trailhead is the vehicle gate (approach_logistics) and Dutch Miller Gap Trailhead is the old road end where the climb actually starts, 7.5 road miles on. 7.9 km straight line is consistent with that. Pin 0 stays the road end; no change.

name: Madison Falls Trailhead
quote: Olympic Hot Springs Road is closed to vehicles at Madison Falls
reason: Madison Falls is the end of vehicle access and Whiskey Bend (7 mi on foot or bike) is where the Elwha Trail starts; 8.1 km straight line fits 7 stored miles. Two real trailheads, not a defect.

name: Hwy 20 pullout near MP 166 (descent finish)
quote: This roadside pullout is where the descent over Burgundy Col comes back to the highway, not where the East Ridge starts.
reason: Legitimate descent-finish second trailhead (shuttle car); 11.6 km from Cedar Creek is expected. Confirmed.

name: Chianti Spire / East Face (Rebel Yell) area
source: pin shares the Summit pin's coordinate; ground 8,167
reason: A base at 7,900 ft cannot be on the summit coordinate. Neither GNIS nor Peakbagger/SummitPost publish a base coordinate, so clear the Base. Summit pin left (never clear a summit; no published summit coordinate found, 166 m from the area coordinate, recorded as unresolved).

name: Talus cirque below the West Face
reason: Coordinate and height agree to 4 ft; the West Face is a steep ~1,000 ft wall, so a cirque 146 m from the summit horizontally is geometrically plausible. Not a defect.

name: Base of east face
reason: Gap is 438 ft, under the 500 ft conviction box, the coordinate is 4 decimal places on a talus base under a ~600 ft face, and nothing published settles it. No sourced write.
